description:
Menu engineering from POS sales with head chef Cristopher's verified costing rules. Send 2-200 dishes with units sold, menu price (inc GST by default) and plate cost; each dish gets contribution margin, menu mix %, food cost % and its class: Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle or Dog (70% popularity rule, sales-weighted average margin), with his action for each. The whole menu is one pool; catering platters are judged on their own. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals are free.

Use when the user has units sold per dish for a period (one week from the POS is enough) and wants each dish classed. Send 2-200 dishes, each with name, unitsSold, menuPrice (as shown on the menu) and plateCost; mark catering platters with catering true. For one dish's price, use calculate_menu_price instead. Pass on each dish's action as given. Costs $0.02. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.

catering.description: Judged in the catering pool. Default: true when section names catering, platter or function.

dryRun.description: Free quote only: check whether this would be answered and what it costs. Nothing is signed or charged.
